description: FacilitateDiscussion - Facilitate a group discussion about {topic}

actions.action_goal: {"id": "facilitate_discussion_{topic_id}", "description": "Facilitate a group discussion where participants talk to each other about their {topic}.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} summarizes or highlights patterns in what the group shared about their {topic}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} invites the group to discuss their {topic} with each other.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "{robot_name} facilitates the group discussion for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address participants as a group (e.g., 'you all', 'everyone') - do NOT use individual names.", "Use open prompts like 'What do you all think?'", "Step back and let participants talk to each other - don't dominate the conversation.", "React naturally to show you're engaged with the group discussion."]}

topic.description: The topic to discuss (e.g., 'favorite school subject', 'favorite color', 'first pet')

discussion_time.description: How long the group discussion should continue (e.g., '5 minutes', '90 seconds')
